parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description:
Retrieves instances by instance status. Separate multiple instance statuses with commas. Valid values:
  • unpaid: Pending payment.
  • paid: Paid.
  • creating: Being created.
  • running: Running.
  • updating: Being upgraded.
  • disable: Unavailable.
  • deleting: Being released.
  • scaling_out: Scaling out.
  • scaling_in: Scaling in.
  • scaling_up: Scaling up.
  • scaling_down: Decrease the quota in progress.
  • upgrading: Version upgrade in progress.
  • modifying_config: Configuration being updated.
  • enable_public_network: Enabling public network access.
  • disable_public_network: Shutdown of public network access in progress.
  • convert_from_trial_to_official: Instance edition upgrade in progress.
  • restarting: Cluster restarting.
  • migration_cluster_to_serverless: Cluster being migrated.
  • actively_disabled: Stopped.
  • enabling: Recover in progress.
  • agent_creating: Agent being created.
  • agent_scaling_up: Agent being scaled up.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.
